name: robots/jkoba0512__genesis_humanoid_rl
title: Genesis Humanoid RL (Unitree G1 walking environment)
intro: Genesis Humanoid RL (Unitree G1 walking environment), adapted from jkoba0512/genesis_humanoid_rl. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
